description: This source file defines a WebSocketManager class for managing WebSocket connections grouped by job_id, including methods for connecting, disconnecting, and broadcasting messages to WebSocket clients.

classes.name: WebSocketManager
classes.description: Manages WebSocket connections grouped by job_id, allowing connections to be added, removed, and messages broadcasted to all connections associated with a particular job_id.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the WebSocketManager with an empty connection dictionary.

methods.name: connect(self, job_id: str, websocket: WebSocket)
methods.description: Accepts a WebSocket connection and adds it to the group associated with the specified job_id.

methods.name: disconnect(self, job_id: str, websocket: WebSocket)
methods.description: Removes a WebSocket connection from the group associated with the specified job_id.

methods.name: broadcast(self, job_id: str, message: dict)
methods.description: Sends a JSON message to all WebSocket connections associated with the specified job_id, handling exceptions that may occur during message sending.
